svg.title: Goose runtime by backend and Wasm engine

cc:Work.dc:title: Goose runtime by backend and Wasm engine
cc:Work.dc:description: Seven adapted LangArena workloads. Medians of 5 samples; whiskers show median absolute deviation. Lower is better. C/native references are from the same-host baseline run. Direct values are the qualified current candidate in the interleaved comparison. Sources, standard libraries, engines and flags match; separately collected runs. Native and C-Wasm generated C is byte-identical between both compiler versions.
